title: TradeLink
description: This Plugin adds an GUI based orders and Auctionhouse where you can Trade items for Items without an economy system.
body:
# TradeLink - The Ultimate Trading System for Players

TradeLink is a professional and intuitive plugin that allows players to create purchase orders for specific items and sell items directly via an integrated Auction House. Forget complicated chat commands – almost everything is controlled via a modern and sleek GUI menu!

## ✨ Main Features
- Full GUI Control: Create and manage your orders easily through interactive menus.

- NEW: Auction House (AH): A fully integrated marketplace where players can list items for sale and demand specific items (like Diamonds or custom currencies) as payment.

- NEW: Dynamic Language System: 100% translatable! Comes with English and German (en.yml, de.yml) by default. Server owners can edit every single text, prefix, and button without touching the code.
  
- Flexible Pricing: Choose between "Price per Item" or "Total Price" when creating an order.
  
- Partial Deliveries: Sellers can fulfill just a fraction of an order and get paid immediately for the delivered amount.
  
- Secure Storage: Rewards, AH earnings, and returned items are securely stored in a virtual "Order Chest" or "Collection Station" until the owner claims them.
  
- Scam Protection: Items are strictly verified before a trade. If your inventory is full, the plugin safely holds your items instead of dropping or deleting them.
  
- Integrated Search: Comfortably search for any item in the game via an interactive sign-input menu while creating an order or setting a payment item.

## How it works
### The Orders System:

- /order - Opens the marketplace.
  
- Create Order: Search for the item you need, set the amount, choose your payment item (currency), and you're done!
  
- Deliver: Other players click on your order, place the requested items into the delivery window, and instantly receive their payment.
  
- Collect: Easily claim your traded items or returned payments via the "My Orders" menu.
### The Auction House (AH):
  
- Selling: Hold the item you want to sell in your main hand and type /ah sell <Payment Item> <Amount> (e.g., /ah sell DIAMOND 5). The item is safely removed and listed globally.
  
- Buying: Open the Auction House menu, browse items, and click to buy. The required payment is automatically taken from your inventory.
  
- Claiming: When someone buys your item, the profits go straight to your secure AH Collection Station for you to pick up!

- NEW: After by default 7 Days the items will be removed from the AH and put into the Collection Station. You can change this time in the config.yml file.
  
### Commands
- /order - Main command to open the Order Marketplace.
  
- /ah - Opens the Auction House menu.
  
- /ah sell - Lists the currently held item on the Auction House.

## 🌍 Fully Customizable Localization
TradeLink features a powerful and easy-to-use language system. No more digging through config files for a single message!

- Automatic Setup: On the first boot, the plugin automatically generates a /lang/ folder containing both en.yml and de.yml.
  
- Simple Configuration: Want to switch languages? Just change the language setting in your config.yml to your desired file name.
  
- Live Editing: You can customize every single button name, lore, prefix, and chat message.
  
- Create Your Own: Simply copy an existing file, rename it (e.g., fr.yml), translate the values, and the plugin will handle the rest!


This project is Open Source! Want to help improve the plugin?

Report bugs or suggest new features on GitHub.

Are you a developer? Pull Requests are highly welcome!
